name: Link Content Parser (Postlight Parser)
description: Extracts article content/metadata from a URL (Postlight/Mercury/Readability). SECURITY: the parser endpoint /parser/{parser}?url= is gated only by 'access content' (anonymous) and, for the readability parser, fetches the CLIENT-supplied URL server-side with file_get_contents/curl (FOLLOWLOCATION), returning the content — an unauthenticated read-SSRF (internal services / cloud-metadata credential theft) and file:// local file read. Do NOT expose it publicly until the URL is validated/allowlisted and the route is properly permissioned.
